python3 -c "
from fixture_api.runtime import X24Decisions
from app.service import run

# Test edge case: trying to prepare with inactive actor
store = X24Decisions()
result = run(store, 'prepare', ('a', 'three'))  # 'three' doesn't exist
print('Prepare with non-existent actor:', result)

# Test edge case: trying to prepare with already inactive actor  
store.rows['a']['one'] = False
result = run(store, 'prepare', ('a', 'one'))
print('Prepare with inactive actor:', result)

# Test edge case: trying to prepare when no other actors active
store = X24Decisions()
store.rows['a']['one'] = False
store.rows['a']['two'] = False
result = run(store, 'prepare', ('a', 'one'))
print('Prepare with no other active actors:', result)
"
